svg.title: NORIKO
svg.desc: Official NORIKO logo. Vector paths transcoded from the supplied noriko logo.ai; coordinates of every retained shape are unaltered. Do not redraw, restyle or recolour. 3831 detached spatter dots from the original autotrace (all under 2 units wide, median 0.4, 0.94% of the black ink) were removed on 30 Aug 2026: at 3918 subpaths Chromium refused to decode the file and the logo rendered as alt text on every page. The 87 shapes that carry the mark are untouched.
